# Retained Ultra source-only recipes

`recipes.json` freezes 42 additive policy-tagged requests and complete independent
state expectations for pinned zstd v1.5.7 revision
`f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99`. It is a source-only manifest, not a
native capture or production-admission fixture. Attribution: `LICENSE.zstd` and
the upstream counterparts recorded in the model/design documentation.

Nineteen retained Optimal sources are preserved under each policy. Two additional
four-block sources combine the previously qualified Ultra alternative seeds 0202
and 2020, again under both policies. The unchanged nested predecessor packets,
all policy-zero state hashes, packet/source/parameter identities, publication
hypotheses, branch witnesses and conservative output bounds are explicit.

The frozen file SHA-256 is
`888f364acc26b310d82b397dd5508a35afb2d000a311858377fc99ce5a715636`.
Ordinary generation and optimized read-only replay agree on 207635 logical events
per padding pass and 348 policy-two alternative events after the first block.
Both modes of `scripts/check_ultra_retained_recipes.py` reject 17 later-block
alternative forgeries and verify first-block isolation from changed future bytes.

Reproduce the complete manifest read-only with `python3 -B
scripts/plan_ultra_retained.py` (also with `-O`). `--write` refuses an existing
destination. Do not regenerate this file from native observations or change the
publication hypotheses to force native agreement; use an additive successor and
preserve any failed original campaign.
